reviews.body:
### 🔵 Needs a closer look Exclusion of late membership actions still needs independent repository/runtime verification beyond the substituted-gateway evidence.
2 open findings - [Refresh and commit derived shard artifacts to fix digest drift](#discussion_r4218254620) · New - [Classify deferred authoritative-read failures as unavailable](#discussion_r4218254688) · New
What changed in this PR Adds a narrow repository transition to resolve terminal message-group membership intent that never authorized an action, without activating recovery or runtime membership work. **Changes:** - Adds guarded non-admission settlement and authoritative readback. - Tests settlement races, replay, holder checks, and lane reuse. - Retains measurement evidence and publication history. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | test/​rebalancer/​message-group-membership-branch-authorization.test.js | Adds terminal non-admission coverage. | | src/​rebalancer/​replica-operation-repository.js | Exposes the settlement method. | | src/​rebalancer/​replica-operation-message-group-membership-owner-claim.js | Implements guarded settlement and shared SQL predicates. | | solve/​quests/​message-group-fresh-identity-membership/​log.ndjson | Records attempts and evidence retention. | | solve/​quests/​message-group-fresh-identity-membership/​evidence/​terminal-nonadmission-37767400569.json | Preserves results, provenance, and proof limits. |
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced --- Give feedback about Copilot approvals in [this survey](https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/9011660/CCR-Public-Preview-Autoapprove-feedback-survey) to enter a drawing for a $150 gift card.

findings.body: A returned authoritative-read failure becomes `conflict` rather than `unavailable`. `queryAuthoritativeOperationById` discards the visibility observation's deferred outcome and returns null, so `observeMembershipOperation` reports an available read and settlement rejects the request as a row conflict. This hides a visibility problem even though no row was observed. Have the shared observer use `queryAuthoritativeOperationVisibilityObservation(operationId, {...READ, requireAbsenceConfirmation: true})` and treat a deferred outcome as unavailable. Add a test where the gateway returns `{success: false}` rather than throwing.

Please run `npm run test:metadata:refresh` and commit the four derived shard artifacts with these source changes. The committed `test/shards/impact-graph-seal.json` does not match the checkout's source-byte digest; `.github/workflows/ci.yml:182-191` regenerates it and fails on that drift, so the focused tests do not make this candidate pass CI.
